purpose: dependency-aware sensitivity controls for the observed source-wave directional concentration
complete_series_rule: exactly one non-null OBS_VALUE at each of 1998, 2003, 2008, 2013
common_wave_null: enumerate all 24 permutations of the four wave labels and apply the same permutation to every complete economy-indicator series; retain the maximum directional concentration across three adjacent positions
cluster_bootstrap: resample complete economies with replacement, preserving all indicators within each economy; 10000 deterministic replicates; calculate observed directional concentration per interval and max across intervals
no_multiple_testing: only the predeclared max across the three adjacent intervals is retained
interpretation_rule: even a small null p-value remains descriptive source-wave concentration; no predictive or causal promotion without an independent vintage and temporal holdout
